title: Public drain_tx_queue bypasses TX lock and double-transmits queue head
description: Python link focused regression: concurrent LinkLayer.send() and public drain_tx_queue() both reserve/transmit the same head because drain_tx_queue does not acquire _tx_lock. Radio calls overlap and one completion sees a non-head entry. Serialize the public drain path with send while retaining an internal already-locked drain helper to avoid self-deadlock; add deterministic barrier coverage and preserve queued-reservation semantics.
